description: This file is a PHP source file defining a class 'Total' for the OpenCart admin extension, specifically within the 'extension/opencart/total' namespace. The class manages the display and saving of total-related settings in the admin panel, handling localization, permissions, configuration retrieval, and rendering of the view.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Defines the admin controller class for managing the 'Total' extension in OpenCart, handling display and save operations for total modules, including permission checks and configuration management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the total settings page in the admin panel, loads language files, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, loads header, sidebar, footer, and renders the total view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of total module settings. Checks user permissions, updates settings if authorized, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
